about_the_game:
Raybounder is a top-down puzzle shooter where you are armed with a unique laser gun that is both a tool for navigation and device for destruction. Master the gun's movement and ricocheting lasers to navigate increasingly complex and challenging environments.

Features:

  • Ricochet Puzzles

Strategically position your gun and unleash beams that bounce off walls and through enemies, clearing a path to the exit.

  • A Unique, Versatile Weapon

Throw your laser gun across gaps and activate distant switches to unlock new areas.

  • Challenging and Varied Environments

Collect gears, unlock cosmetics, and earn achievements across 12+ stages and 60+ levels.

Perfect your aim, master your throws, and prove your mettle in Raybounder!

name: Raybounder Demo
short_description: A unique top-down puzzle shooter where you control a robot with an unusual weapon. Throw your laser gun across gaps, hit switches, and fire the gun to shoot beams that ricochet off walls, destroy enemies, and hit targets. Make every shot count as you solve puzzles in 60+ stages!
